title: 인터넷 설치 신청: 언제, 어디에 설치할까요?
objective: You can call an internet company and give your address, visit date, and phone number.
summary: Practice a phone call to request internet installation with V-을/ㄹ + noun.
setting: A phone call to an internet company's customer center. The caller is moving next week and wants internet installed at the new apartment.

task.title: Use the call expressions
task.line: Use the dialogue, the word list, and the V-을/ㄹ + noun pattern to complete each task.

words.meaning: installation (setting up a machine or service)
words.exampleMeaning: Installing the air conditioner takes about two hours.

words.example: 택배를 보낼 때 주소를 꼭 쓰세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Be sure to write the address when you send a package.

words.example: 공유기가 고장 나서 와이파이가 안 돼요.
words.exampleMeaning: The router is broken, so the Wi-Fi doesn't work.
The moving date hasn't been decided yet.

dialogue.korean: 인터넷 설치를 신청하고 싶어요. 다음 주에 이사해요.
dialogue.meaning: I'd like to apply for internet installation. I'm moving next week.
Sure. Could you tell me the address where we will install it?
Shall we install a Wi-Fi router too?

dialogue.korean: 네, 같이 해 주세요. 기사님은 언제 오세요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, please do both. When will the technician come?

dialogue.korean: 기사님이 방문할 날짜를 골라 주세요. 평일하고 주말 모두 가능합니다.
dialogue.meaning: Please choose the date for the technician's visit. Both weekdays and weekends are available.

dialogue.korean: 네, 그럼 연락받을 전화번호를 말씀해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: All right. Then please tell me a phone number where we can reach you.

exercises: Change the verb into the -을/ㄹ form: ① 저녁에 ____ 음식을 샀어요. (먹다) ② 주말에 ____ 영화를 찾고 있어요. (보다) ③ 비행기에서 ____ 책을 가방에 넣었어요. (읽다)
Fill in the blank with a word from the word list: ① 와이파이가 안 돼요. ____가 고장 났어요. ② 새 집 ____를 아직 몰라요. ③ 내일 ____이 와서 인터넷을 설치해요.
Say it in Korean, using V-을/ㄹ + noun: "Please tell me the date you will move."
Read the dialogue and answer in English: When will the technician come, and what will they install besides the internet?
answers: ① 먹을 ② 볼 ③ 읽을
① 공유기 ② 주소 ③ 기사님
이사할 날짜를 알려 주세요. (이사할 날짜를 말씀해 주세요.)
On Saturday morning. They will also install a Wi-Fi router (공유기).
